title: Zero Copy Federation vs Reverse ETL for Real-Time Segmentation

steps.prompt: Marketing needs Snowflake behavioral scores in Salesforce for near-real-time segmentation. The lake holds 50TB of raw clickstream; leadership rejects duplicating it into Salesforce storage or paying continuous API ingest fees. Which architecture best satisfies freshness, cost, and Trust?

options.label: Scheduled reverse ETL sync copying aggregated behavioral scores into Custom Big Objects via Bulk API
options.distractorAntipattern: Duplicating lake data into Big Objects incurs massive storage overhead, high ingest latency, and stale segmentation.
options.rationale: Copying massive telemetry into Custom Big Objects duplicates storage costs, creates pipeline lag, and violates leadership requirement to avoid data duplication.

options.label: Data 360 Zero Copy federation to Snowflake, querying governed lake shares directly without data movement
options.rationale: Zero Copy federation connects Data 360 directly to Snowflake shares, providing live query access for segmentation without data duplication or ingestion fees.

options.label: Synchronous External Services REST callouts querying Snowflake on-demand during segment evaluations
options.distractorAntipattern: Synchronous callouts during segmentation create severe API rate limiting, high latency, and lack lake-level SQL pushdown.
options.rationale: Synchronous API callouts cannot support complex audience segmentation queries across 50TB datasets and trigger severe API throttling.
